output.scope_note: The paper studies dielectric relaxation and ionic conductivity of a plastic-crystal mixture (60% succinonitrile, 40% glutaronitrile), which is not a solid Li- or Na-ion conductor, and it reports no explicit ionic conductivity value at a given temperature (only dc resistivity in a figure and fit parameters, plus a reference conductivity of 1e-15 used to define a glass temperature).
